name: print-social-world-diabetes-day-posts-lime-pink-torn-paper-edges
title: World Diabetes Day pack in lime green and pink with torn-paper edges and numbered info cards
whatItIs: Five lime-green square posts with jagged torn-paper pink accents, bold black headlines ('Protect Your Family', 'World Diabetes Awareness'), an illustrated insulin bottle, numbered info cards (01, 02), a small earth icon and date details for a November campaign.
whatItMeans: Urgent yet approachable; torn-paper edges give a health-awareness campaign a hand-made, grassroots energy.
techniques: Use jagged torn-paper shapes as accent decoration.
Number key facts for easy scanning.
Illustrate the relevant medical object (insulin bottle) directly.

vocabulary.definition: A jagged shape mimicking ripped paper.
A card presenting one fact or step in a list.
